language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon initially lies on the tabletop (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot closes its fingers around the handle and lifts the spoon (frames 76–100, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then carries it to the open drawer (frames 120–178, image and left_ego_image). It releases the spoon at frames 183–190; the spoon settles inside the drawer and remains there with the gripper empty through frame 205 (image and wrist_image). No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or unrelated object displacement is visible.
